Taking a bike or trike apart, teardown order: photograph the bike whole, remove the wheels, then the chain, cranks, bottom bracket, headset, fork, and finally brakes and cables. Bag each group and label the bag with a masking-tape tag. Measure bearing sizes before discarding anything. Torque notes: [[torque-in-newton-metres]].
